title: Requirements Traceability Map
description: Schema for generated requirements traceability map — maps product goals to requirement IDs and records authority-chain metadata. Authority: AUTHORITATIVE after DEC-034 IV (GOVERNANCE.md 26.11). AI_PROPOSAL source count MUST be 0 for authoritative maps.

format.description: Format identifier — must match the containing directory name

generator_version.description: Version of the requirements generator that produced this map

generation_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this map was generated

product_goal_coverage.description: Map of product goal IDs to their requirement coverage status

requirements.description: Requirement IDs that address this product goal

coverage.description: Coverage verdict for this product goal

accepted_for_vertical_slice.description: Requirement IDs accepted for vertical slice implementation — must be non-empty for AUTHORITATIVE maps

deferred_requirements.description: Requirement IDs deferred from vertical slice (NEEDS_REVIEW, GENERATED, or explicitly future-scoped)

critical_requirements.description: Optional: List of critical implementation constraints (e.g. iterative traversal requirements). Each entry is a {requirement_id: constraint_description} map.

additionalProperties.description: Human-readable constraint description that MUST be enforced in implementation

spec_citations.description: Map of ODF spec section references to the requirement IDs they ground

source_evidence_summary.description: Count of requirements by source_type. AI_PROPOSAL MUST be 0 for an AUTHORITATIVE traceability map.

EXISTING_SOURCE.description: Requirements grounded in confirmed existing source files

TEST_EVIDENCE.description: Requirements grounded in existing test files

PRODUCT_DECISION.description: Requirements grounded in explicit product decisions

AI_PROPOSAL.description: AUTHORITY GATE: MUST be 0 for AUTHORITATIVE maps. AI_PROPOSAL requirements cannot drive implementation without verifier review + DEC-034 IV. maximum:0 is machine-enforceable; validator will reject AI_PROPOSAL > 0.
